suppress.notes: Disposition: false_positive. CVE-2026-23907 and CVE-2026-33929 affect only Apache PDFBox Examples (org.apache.pdfbox:pdfbox-examples), specifically ExtractEmbeddedFiles. The scanned artifact is the distinct JBIG2 ImageIO plugin; version 3.0.5 is the current vendor release and does not contain the affected class. Vendor advisory: https://pdfbox.apache.org/security.html Review when JBIG2 is upgraded, NVD/CPE mapping changes, or by 2027-01-31.

Disposition: false_positive. The scanned package is this project's internal Camel adapter. Dependency-Check assigned it a low-confidence CPE for Processing Foundation Processing because both names contain "processing". CVE-2018-1000840 concerns Processing's loadXML() implementation, which this Maven artifact does not contain. Advisory: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2018-1000840 Review if the artifact coordinates or CPE mapping change, or by 2027-01-31.
